backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md core multi-window protocol plus Space frozen snapshots

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies; forward replacement profiles come from closed 2026 event-state ledger rows, so any helper remains default-off metadata and live Space slots stay zero.

attention_overlay_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

government_contract_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_depth.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

single_event_defense_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

gate_questions.q1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: top up accepted official Space signals where 10d event-state evidence is cash/SPY/UFO-positive but same-theme replacement is non-positive.
q2_prior_experiments: exp-20260514-002 accepted same-theme replacement-strength risk at $500 / 1.05x.
exp-20260514-009 accepted same-theme replacement-strength trend-only risk at 1.05x.
exp-20260514-010/011 rejected 5d confirmation because only old_thin improved.
exp-20260514-013 rejected negative 10d same-theme/cash profile haircuts.
This test is not a same-theme floor retune; it tests an ETF benchmark-relative positive state when same-theme is negative.
gate_questions.q3_single_causal_variable: Only the benchmark-positive same-theme-laggard risk scalar changes; accepted exp-009 stack and all entries/exits/ranking/targets stay fixed.
gate_questions.q4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown damage <= 0.5pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 aggregate trades, and real adjusted signals.

hypothesis: The accepted Space forward stack may be under-allocating official catalyst tickers whose 10d cash, SPY-relative, and UFO-relative profiles are positive even when same-theme replacement value is negative. This tests a benchmark-relative replacement-value scalar on top of accepted exp-20260514-009 without adding tickers, broad filters, LLM authority, lifecycle rules, or live Space slots.
known_risks: The Space sleeve remains default-off and historical Space snapshots are frozen research copies.
Forward replacement profiles are closed 2026 outcomes and should not be treated as proof for live routing.
The state is sparse and may mostly identify PL under the current frozen ledger.
next_evidence_needed: Do not promote benchmark-positive same-theme-laggard risk from this frozen replay. Same-theme replacement remains the stronger accepted Space allocation axis until more closed rows say otherwise.

locked_variables: all prior accepted Space risk helpers

rejection_reason: No tested benchmark-positive same-theme-laggard scalar improved aggregate EV/PnL across the three windows without a window-level EV regression, drawdown/survival violation, or zero-adjustment result.
single_causal_variable: risk scalar for accepted official Space signals with 10d cash/SPY/UFO positive and same-theme replacement <= 0
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking remains label-thin; VSAT and broad satcom expansion failed the three-window gate; 5d confirmation and negative-profile forward variants were rejected. This tests whether benchmark-relative closed-forward evidence can add value where same-theme replacement is deliberately not confirming.
